system.description:
You are always connected to the power of the natural elements around you, and can draw from their power at no additional cost to yourself.

If a naturally occurring source of an element is within range when you make a Focused Attack or use a Targeted Skill, your attack or skill can originate from that source instead of yourself. The use of that skill does not consume a Skill's limit, but does consume the source it originated from if it is Magnitude 2 or smaller.
